newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton rates gain in quality hunt.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton rates gain in quality hunt.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates rose on Wednesday as spinners chased quality stocks, fearing a shortfall. Dealers said rates would rise further in line with buoyant international prices.
"Concern for quality and unattractive import cost amid rising rates in the international market have forced spinners to buy from the domestic market," dealer Mustafa Hussain said.
In the kerb market NIAB-78 variety was traded at 2,250 rupees ($55.94) per maund (37.32 kg), the dealer said.
